title: US bond yields climb to multi-year highs as oil surge revives bets on higher Fed rates - The Economic Times
text:
US Treasury yields hit multiyear highs as a sharp rise in oil prices revived inflation concerns and boosted bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike. The 10-year yield approached 5%, while rising government debt supply and fiscal worries added pressure to bonds ahead of crucial US inflation data.
